utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey everyone, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything about the repair drive? Sounds like it's coming together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, no worries! We're on track for Saturday—just sorting out supplies and making sure everyone's clear on the plan. You're still in for the basic fixes at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, totally—basic fixes at the community center, I can handle that. Thanks for keeping me looped in, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Uli, I've got Marcus's garage set up as the main drop-off point. Can you help coordinate what time people should arrive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure thing, Opal. I'll make a schedule and post it on the community board this evening—morning shift for drop-offs, afternoon for hands-on repairs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great thinking, Uli—that way we can stagger the flow and keep things running smoothly all day.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Well, I'm trying to nail down the exact start time—Eli said 9 but Vik told me 10. You know anything?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've just been hearing second-hand stuff too, but I'd go with 9 to be safe and grab a good spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, 9 sounds right, better early than late. You planning to come by and help out?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Noah, the repair drive's this Saturday at the community center. Bring any broken tools—we'll fix 'em up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday, right. I think I have that old drill somewhere... or was it a saw? I'll check, but no promises I'll remember by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring whatever you find, even if it's rusty. We'll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Tess, I just realized the repair drive might be on Saturday, not tomorrow—Vik and Quinn have been giving me different stories.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard it's actually on Sunday now—Rosa told me the flyer was outdated!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sunday too? Jeez, we really need to get our stories straight—I don't want to show up on the wrong day with a toolbox and no one else around.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus, yeah I'm just planning to swing by on Saturday with my toaster, see if they can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll be around Saturday too—just holler if you need a screwdriver or a multimeter.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks Gus, appreciate it—might just take you up on that if my toaster's being stubborn.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the flyer! Let me check my counter—I think I left it there, but it might also be in my jacket pocket. I'll find it for you, Rey.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I just want to make sure I haven't missed any updates about the timing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No problem, Rey! I'm sure it's around here somewhere—maybe I'll spot it while I'm looking for my glasses.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for taking care of the sign-up sheet, Faye!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No problem, Mara! Saturday's looking good—glad you can bring your toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I'll have it ready. Let's make sure we have a good spot for everyone to work.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just a bit nervous about the parts situation—did anyone confirm they'll have the right screws for small appliances?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I hear you! I actually confirmed with the hardware store yesterday—they're donating a box of assorted screws and small parts, so we should be covered.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief! I hope they also have the right size for my blender's base plate—I wouldn't want to bring it all the way there for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! I'm glad I ran into you—are you in for the repair drive this weekend? We could really use another set of hands!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh hey Jules! Absolutely, I'm all in. Just point me at whatever needs fixing or hauling, and I'll get to it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's awesome, Sam! I'll put you down for the heavy lifting crew—we've got a few old couches and a washing machine that need moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to see you, Kira. The repair drive is set for 9 AM sharp this Saturday, and we've got tools from Gus. Will you be joining us?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure I'm organizing this? I keep hearing different things from everyone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rest assured, Kira, I'm the one organizing it. We're starting at 9 AM this Saturday, and Gus is bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Hana! I'm getting everyone together for a playground repair drive this Saturday—can I count you in? We're meeting at the playground at 9.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Count me in! But have you had a chance to look at the error log yet? I'd like to review it together before we start working.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not yet, but bring it along on Saturday—we can look it over together before we start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we go any further, Sam, did you get a chance to look at the error log? I think it's important we review it together first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, the error log—right, I totally meant to check that! Give me a sec to pull it up on my phone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks Sam. Let's go through it line by line so we catch everything before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Faye, do you know the exact start time for the repair drive this Saturday? I keep getting mixed messages.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm aiming for a 10 AM start on Saturday—that way it's after school drop-offs and before the afternoon chaos. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, 10 AM works for me. Who's bringing the tools—should I grab my drill?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hey Noah, I'm planning to head over to the repair drive on Saturday with some tools from my shed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Saturday? Right, the repair drive. I still need to find that drill... maybe I'll remember by then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: If you can't find yours, I've got a spare drill you can borrow for the day.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oren, good you're here—I've got a list of supplies we'll need for Saturday. Can you help me check if we've got enough?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday? Right, the repair drive! I think I have a wrench somewhere... let me go check my garage.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks Oren—a wrench would be great. We're short on screwdrivers too, so if you've got a set, toss it in the box by my front door.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules! We're combining efforts with Opal for a big neighborhood repair drive this Saturday—playground equipment and community center roof both. Can I count you in?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Quinn! I've been rallying folks already, so just tell me what you need me to bring or help set up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Jules! Could you bring some basic tools like wrenches and screwdrivers? We're meeting at Marcus's garage at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Dane! Have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing up old appliances for free!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I heard about it from Rosa—something about Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's right! Rosa's been helping sort out the details. Are you planning to bring anything in for fixing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's reassuring, Leo. Maybe I'll bring the blender by Saturday morning. Do you think you could take a quick look at it before the drive officially starts?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I can take a quick look Saturday morning. Just bring it by my garage around 9.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, I'll be there at 9. Thanks, Leo—I'll put it in a box tonight so I don't forget.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just a heads up, the main drop-off is at Marcus's garage—I've got a map of everyone's locations if you need directions.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to know—I'll come by to grab that map from you before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, stop by my place anytime before Saturday—I'll have the map ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Vik, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm thinking of bringing my wobbly chair.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I heard it's this Saturday! Cleo and Mina are organizing it. I'm bringing some old screwdrivers—do you have anything else besides the chair?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've also got a broken toaster—hoping someone can take a look at it. Are you planning to help fix stuff too?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Eli! Great to see you. Just a heads up, the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center—can we count on you?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, well—that's a surprise. I've got it down for Saturday at 9 AM sharp. Let me check my notes again to make sure I'm not mixing things up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries at all, Eli! It was a last-minute change—Saturday's forecast is rain, so we moved to Sunday at 10 AM at the community center. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I've been hearing mixed things about the repair drive—Vik said one thing, Mina another. What's the real plan?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: See, this is exactly what I mean—I keep getting told I'm organizing it, but I never signed up for that. Are you sure it's me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I'm sorry, Kira—I thought you were in the loop. I heard from Vik it was Saturday, but Mina's pushing for it sooner. Maybe we need to get everyone together to sort it out.
